title: MV Changing Menu Background on different situations

posts.author: sparta212
posts.body:
Hello everyone, I hope you're doing great!
I'm using this plugin:
Menu Backgrounds
for my game, and I was wondering if there is a way to change the background images depending on different situations like the images change from one location to another.
Thanks in advance !

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
You can use the script call
Code:
_.backgrounds[scene name] = filename
i.e.
_.backgrounds["Scene_Menu"] = "lotsOfClouds";[/code]

Note that this change will not save when you quit and resume a game. You may also see glitches with loading times the first time you open that window.

posts.author: TobyYasha
posts.body:
you could try storing the value in a variable.
and to set the value back when loading a game you could:
- have an autorun event that does it on every map
- use a plugin that runs a common event when loading a save file.
And here's how you can set the value if using a variable:
Code:
SRD.MenuBackgrounds.backgrounds["Scene_Menu"] = $gameVariables.value(1);
Very important, if you use this code make sure you check that your variable value isn't 0 otherwise you could get a crash.
And if you want to store a string in a variable make sure you write the string in the "script" field of that variable.
i noticed ATT_Turan uses a "_" instead of "SRD.MenuBackgrounds" which wouldn't work because that's incorrect, so i corrected his example for you.
Code:
SRD.MenuBackgrounds.backgrounds["Scene_Menu"] = "lotsOfClouds";
